text:
maya: Heads-up — during qbringup of q4b-int8 onstage we spotted a small but repeatable quality dip on a subset of our promptbank. ~4% lower BLEU on the 'transformation' slice (short instructions -> creative rewrite). 😕
ricardo: Can you paste an example prompt + model output? Might be tokenizer truncation or kv-cache mismatch with quant kernels.
maya: Example: 
```
prompt: Convert the following technical note into a playful haiku: 'GPU batch size tuning is tricky at scale.'
ref: [our human rewrite]
q4b-int8 output: "Tuning batch sizes
cloud hum, GPUs whisper slow
scale bites the morning"
baseline (fp16): "Tuning batch size
cloud hums; GPUs dance light
scale learns to breathe"
```
The q4b-int8 has odd rephrasing behavior and sometimes drops key phrases. It's concentrated on short instructional->creative tasks.
sam: Hmm — that aligns with a tokenizer boundary issue we saw with the new tokenizer v2. If tokens split punctuation differently, model might miss cues. Can we run a quick dedupe/hash on that slice to see overlap with other seeds?
anya: I can spin up a quick curation job. Which golden set should we compare against? current: `golden/creative_short_v2.json` or the older `golden/creative_master.json`?
maya: Use `golden/creative_short_v2.json` first — that's what our eval harness used for the qbringup. Also add a sample of 500 recent ingests from `samplebank/transform_short` for context.
jules: I'll queue labeler batch #8812 to recheck edgecases and mark hallucination/drop tokens. @labeling-bot can you attach the batch URL and ETA?
labeling-bot: Batch created: https://labeler.internal/batches/8812 — ETA to completion ~ 18h, 12 labelers assigned. Reaction: :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ricardo: Thanks. Also can eng-runtime run an int8 vs fp16 token-by-token alignment for 200 examples? Need to see where divergence starts (prefix, middle, or tail). If it's prefix we probably broke KV cache offsets in the quant kernel.
sam: I can run a micro-benchmark today — will push a short script to `eng-ml/benchmarks/q4b_token_align` and share results. If it's kernel-related we'll triage with eng-runtime.
anya: For curation: I'll filter for prompts with <40 tokens, creative/instruction label, and drop duplicates by fuzzyhash threshold 0.85. Also plan to add 200 handcrafted golden rewrites to expand coverage. Anyone want to volunteer examples?
jules: I'll send 50 from support transcripts that hit this pattern.
maya: Great. Once labeling finishes and bench results are in, we should consider a small golden refresh PR (`docs/evals/golden-refresh-2026-03`) and rerun the qbringup canary. Can we aim to have a decision by EOD tomorrow?
ricardo: Sounds good. Quick note: add a metric in the eval harness for "instruction-preservation" (binary flag when key noun/phrase in prompt is present in output). That will make regressions easier to spot vs aggregate BLEU.
sam: Good call — I'll add it to the harness and post the PR link.
maya: Thanks all. I'll monitor the labeler batch and post interim samples. :thumbsup:
